tags.name: Phone numbers
tags.description:
This method group is used for retrieving and updating DID number assigned to your account as well as ordering new ones.

To order new numbers, you must first select a country - use `GET /dids/new-numbers/countries` endpoint to see a list of available countries and get country resource ID.

Then, you need to get price group resource ID, that is required for creating an order. Use `GET /dids/new-numbers/countries/{id}/price-groups` (where id is country resource id) endpoint to retrieve a list of available numbers for a specific country.

Finally, send a request to `POST /dids/orders` with your desired price group resource ID. For other necessary fields, check `POST /dids/orders` request body.
